jobs.title: Data Center Chief Engineer
jobs.description:
Description

Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response. The CE serves as an expert technical resource interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support AWS.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States

NOTE: Relocation assistance will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities

Act as the primary escalation point for all facilities-related issues. Oversee operation and management of routine and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.

Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures and troubleshooting of facility within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).

Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians and are responsible for working with Facility Manager (FM) to set team culture.

Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams

May assist in the building out of new facilities and assist in projects to increase current facility efficiency

Working outside of normal business hours for routine maintenance as required, including responding to out-of-hours emergency calls.

Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience.

Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency

Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff

Establish building performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility of operations and maintenance.

Utilize Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook and other basic administrative tools to perform day-to-day tasks

Physical Requirements

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodation:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

Essential Requirements

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

About The Team

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 2+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance, or 3+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance experience
Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
3+ years of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel experience

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in data center engineering or operations
Experience in construction or project management
Experience leading technical teams through daily operations and maintenance evolutions
Can work in an environment that involves walking, stooping, bending, and climbing to access equipment

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. jobs.title: Director of Technology
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The organization knows that excellent teaching is the most important driver of student success. The moment a student steps foot in the classroom, their opportunity to learn depends on how prepared their teacher is to translate complex content knowledge, standards, and their knowledge of that student into lessons that help them learn deeply and apply their thinking to the real world.

That’s a big lift, and it often happens alone. As a national nonprofit, the organization partners with school systems to overcome persistent instructional challenges, foster intentional collaboration and adult learning by design, and ignite new possibilities through systemic solutions at the intersection of teaching, talent, and technology.

The organization works shoulder-to-shoulder with educators at every level of the education system to strengthen their instructional and leadership practices, bring a vision for excellent instruction to life with consistency, and ensure every student reaches their full potential.

Through direct support, strategic advising, innovation pilots, and best-in-class research, the organization helps educators work toward a future where every student is ready to thrive.

Position

As the organization's senior technology leader, this role will shape and execute the technology vision and strategy in direct support of the mission to ensure every student succeeds in school and in life. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this individual will provide strategic leadership across technology strategy, systems and security, AI governance, organizational technology adoption, and technology operations—driving decisions that enable educators to focus on what they do best: teaching.

This is a role of significant influence and impact. This individual will not just manage infrastructure; they will architect the technology ecosystem that empowers the team to work shoulder-to-shoulder with school systems to overcome instructional challenges, foster collaboration, and ignite new possibilities at the intersection of teaching, talent, and technology. Every decision made will ripple through the organization and ultimately support students' success.

Leading a small, talented technology team, this role will ensure that the organization's technology investments are secure, scalable, sustainable, and—most importantly—effectively adopted across the organization. This individual will build organizational capacity to translate technology investments into everyday practices that drive real results. This is an opportunity to lead with vision, mentor emerging talent, and demonstrate how strategic technology leadership advances educational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

• Developing and executing multi-year technology roadmaps that align IT strategy with organizational priorities, scalability, and long-term sustainability.
• Leading technology transformation and modernization initiatives across complex organizations, including managing change, building adoption, and ensuring staff readiness.
• Establishing governance frameworks and policies for responsible AI adoption, data protection, cybersecurity, and organizational risk management.
• Managing technology vendors, budgets, and investments while maximizing value and ensuring quality service delivery.
• Translating complex technical concepts and strategic decisions into clear, compelling language for nontechnical leaders and stakeholders.
• Building and developing high-performing teams, supporting professional growth, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and accountability.
• Bridging technical solutions with organizational strategy and culture, ensuring technology serves people, mission, and organizational priorities rather than the reverse.
• Taking on strategic challenges that require both deep technical expertise and thoughtful change leadership.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field and 10+ years of progressive experience in technology, IT, enterprise systems, digital transformation, or related areas.
• Demonstrated experience developing and executing technology strategy and multi-year roadmaps aligned with organizational priorities.
• Proven track record leading technology transformation, modernization, or systems change across an organization, including successful change management and adoption.
• Experience leading AI enablement, adoption, or governance within an organization, with the ability to evaluate emerging technologies and translate them into responsible organizational use.
• Strong working knowledge of cybersecurity, data protection, enterprise systems, technology risk, and governance, with the ability to provide strategic oversight of these areas.
• Experience developing and governing organizational technology policies and standards, including responsible AI use, data governance, and technology risk.
• Experience overseeing technology vendors, external partners, technology investments, and budgets.
• Proven ability to manage IT teams with a track record of supporting professional development and driving performance.

Travel Requirements

• This is a remote position that requires limited travel.
• National travel for org retreats, programming, job related travel, donor meetings or professional development.
• Outside of the above mentioned travel, this person will work from a home office that must be located anywhere within the U.S.

Why Work Here

Imagine being part of an organization where ideas and perspectives are highly valued. The organization believes in fostering individual strengths, encouraging personal growth, and embracing innovative ideas. If you thrive in a remote working environment, with the added excitement of travel, this is a perfect fit. By joining, you become part of a powerful community of peers nationwide. Regardless of location, you possess the power to make a significant impact on both students and teachers who rely on the organization daily. Join and become an integral part of driving progress in education.

About the Mission & Values

Mission: The organization partners with school systems to sustain the teaching, leadership, and conditions for every student to succeed in school and in life.

Values

• Build on strengths: Affirm and begin with the unique and collective talents, experiences, and wisdom of ourselves and others.
• Continuously learn: Develop ourselves and others. Apply new learning and deepened self-awareness to relationships and practices.
• Prioritize people: Build trust and reflect on the impact of different perspectives and experiences.
• Champion success for all: Re-imagine structures, habits, and mindsets to ensure every learner has access to evidence-based learning opportunities.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring

• Artificial intelligence–enabled tools are used throughout the hiring process, from the moment a candidate applies through the offer stage, to support administrative tasks and the initial review of candidate materials. These tools help organize, analyze, and surface relevant information efficiently, but they do not make hiring decisions.
• All candidate materials—including applications, resumes, assessments, and interview feedback—are reviewed and evaluated by people. All hiring decisions, including interview selection, advancement, and offers of employment, are made by humans.
• AI is used solely as a support tool to assist with early-stage reviews and process efficiency. AI is not used in ways that discriminate based on protected characteristics, nor are ZIP codes or similar data used to target or exclude protected groups. Hiring practices are designed to be fair, consistent, and aligned with equal employment opportunity standards.

Benefits

Compensation

• The base salary range is $127,487 to $172,483 per year. Most new hires enter the range at a specific point based on their qualifications and the role level. For this position, the standard starting salary is $149,985, which is based on meeting the minimum requirement of 10 years of relevant experience.
• If you have more than 10 years of directly relevant experience, your starting salary may be adjusted higher within the range, up to a maximum starting salary of $159,627. This approach ensures that candidates with additional experience beyond the minimum are recognized in the initial salary offer.

Benefits: 100% paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for individual employees. Additional premium costs are covered 60% by the organization for partners and dependents on medical, dental, and vision plans. 4% matching 401k plan, Flexible Spending Accounts for medical, childcare and commuter expenses, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). Benefits are valued at or above $9,000 for employees.

Time Off

• First three years of employment, full time staff accrue 22 days a year.
• Five additional days are accrued after the third and sixth year of employment.
• The organization also offers 16 additional paid days off for various holidays, including three floating holidays staff may use at their discretion.

Equal Opportunity Employment

The organization is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, military status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

jobs.description:
Description

POSITION DESCRIPTION:

We are looking for a Director, Platform Management to join EnFin’s Enterprise Planning & PMO function as the subject matter expert and strategic owner of EnFin’s proposal and design platform ecosystem. You will serve as the internal authority on platform capabilities, configuration best practices, and cross-tool integrations – ensuring EnFin products are accurately and seamlessly embedded in installer workflows at the point of sale. You will define how the platforms are configured and integrated, advise internal teams on technical platform decisions, and own the integration layer between proposal platforms and EnFin's broader technology stack. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role that sits at the intersection of product, technology, and sales.

This position will be based out of the San Francisco, CA or Irvine, CA office, with an in-office schedule during regular working hours Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (local time) and in accordance with the company policies and procedures. Remote work may be considered in exceptional cases.

Responsibilities

Platform Expertise & Technical Ownership

Serve as EnFin's internal subject matter expert on proposal and design platforms (Aurora Solar and others), maintaining deep knowledge of platform capabilities, configuration options, roadmap direction, and best practices.
Own how EnFin configures and leverages proposal platforms – defining technical standards, prioritizing platform capabilities, and advising internal stakeholders on platform decisions that impact installer experience and conversion.
Lead the technical implementation of a multi-platform approach that ensures EnFin products are natively and accurately embedded at the point of sale, working closely with product, sales, and operations teams.
Evaluate and recommend new platform partnerships or tooling as EnFin expands into new installer segments, products, or geographies.
Serve as the primary internal voice for what installers need from proposal tools, translating channel feedback and platform expertise into actionable requirements for product and technology teams.
Establish platform governance frameworks, performance metrics, and success criteria that ensure platform usage aligns with company objectives and delivers measurable business outcomes.
Advise the operations team on platform configuration and settings — setting guardrails and best practices while empowering them to handle day-to-day adjustments.

Integration Architecture & Cross-Tool Ownership

Own the integration layer between proposal platforms and EnFin's broader technology stack, serving as the technical authority on how data flows between systems.
Lead cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Operations to design, implement, and maintain reliable integrations that support accurate proposals and seamless installer workflows.
Define integration standards, technical requirements, and operating models that ensure reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
Own integration health and performance — defining KPIs, establishing monitoring frameworks, and driving continuous improvement.
Develop and oversee issue escalation and incident response processes, ensuring rapid resolution of integration failures and minimal business disruption.
Drive ongoing optimization of data flows and platform capabilities to support new products, channels, and an improved installer experience.

Cross-functional Execution

Serve as the connective tissue between external platform partners and internal teams — translating platform capabilities into business requirements and vice versa.
Run structured governance for active platform partnerships: regular business reviews, integration health check-ins, and escalation management.
Communicate platform status, integration health, risks, and milestones to leadership proactively, flagging issues early and presenting clear options.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, Finance, or a related field; with a minimum of 12+ years of professional experience, including 8-10+ partnerships, product management, business development or integration management ideally in fintech, cleantech or SaaS platforms, with at least 3+ years in a director-level or equivalent leadership role.
Demonstrated experience owning or managing a technology platform partnership from contract through integration launch and ongoing performance management.
Working knowledge of API integrations, comfortable translating between business requirements and technical specifications.
Track record of driving measurable commercial outcomes: attach rate improvement, conversion lift or equivalent growth metrics.
Prior experience with cross-functional collaboration.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience with proposal platforms like Aurora Solar, Solargraf, OpenSolar, or equivalent.
Experience in the residential solar financing industry
MBA or equivalent advanced degree

We provide an opportunity to be part of an exciting and growing world-class global business in an interesting and expanding industry of the future.

jobs.title: Head of Data
jobs.description:
Welcome to Fi.

We’re a passionate team from Square, Google, Oura, Peloton, Uber, and more working to transform the human-pet relationship. Our mission? Develop cutting-edge technology to revolutionize what it means to be a pet parent. The pet industry remains firmly stuck in the past and we are here to change that. Fi is leveraging our team's talent and expertise to improve the lives of millions of pets in the U.S. Real-time location tracking, activity, sleep and behavior monitoring - and that's just the beginning.

The most exciting aspect of our work? Bridging the communication gap between pets and humans. Imagine a world where everyone knows how their pet feels in real time and how to keep their best friend in good shape. That's the future we're building at Fi.

If you're someone who thrives in innovative, collaborative work environments and feels strongly about helping pets live longer, better lives, Fi could be the perfect fit. Join us in our pursuit of the “impossible,” or as we call it here “let me find a way,” to redefine the future of pet ownership together.

Fi is looking for a Head of Data!

Fi is looking for a Head of Data
to own our data platform end to end. You'll model our device, membership, and operational data into the pipelines and warehouse layers the company runs on, lead a team of four analysts, and be the numbers person Finance and Product turn to for board reporting, forecasting, and experiment reads. This is a hands-on role for someone who's built a data function before and wants to do it again, this time with real leverage.

What You'll Do:

Own Fi's data platform and analytics roadmap: model our device, membership, and operational data into pipelines and warehouse layers the whole company can build on
Design and maintain event-driven, incremental pipelines over raw device telemetry — turning millions of collar signals into usable product and fleet data models
Manage, coach, and grow a team of four analysts; run their pipeline of work, unblock them technically, and raise the bar on rigor and documentation
Partner with Finance on subscription and unit economics: membership forecasting, retention and LTV modeling, hardware margin, and the reporting our board and investors see
Partner with Product and Hardware on activation, engagement, and device performance analytics — including the sensor and firmware data behind features customers actually feel
Build self-serve BI that stakeholders genuinely use, rather than a dashboard graveyard
Design and read experiments on pricing, onboarding, and retention, and hold the org to honest interpretation of results

Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response. The CE serves as an expert technical resource interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support AWS.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. We are looking for a Director, Platform Management to join EnFin’s Enterprise Planning & PMO function as the subject matter expert and strategic owner of EnFin’s proposal and design platform ecosystem. This position will be based out of the San Francisco, CA or Irvine, CA office, with an in-office schedule during regular working hours Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (local time) and in accordance with the company policies and procedures. Remote work may be considered in exceptional cases.

Drive ongoing optimization of data flows and platform capabilities to support new products, channels, and an improved installer experience.

Cross-functional Execution

Track record of driving measurable commercial outcomes: attach rate improvement, conversion lift or equivalent growth metrics.
Prior experience with cross-functional collaboration.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Direct experience with proposal platforms like Aurora Solar, Solargraf, OpenSolar, or equivalent.
Experience in the residential solar financing industry
MBA or equivalent advanced degree

Fluency in dimensional and event-driven modeling, and clear opinions on ELT tradeoffs, incremental builds, and cost control

Comfort partnering with Finance on models that carry real consequences: forecasts, diligence materials, margin analysis
Ability to work in ambiguity at Series B scale, where you'll sometimes be the entire data team for a given problem
